articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: How Investors May Respond To Bank of America (BAC) Accounting Shift And Fixed-Income, Digital Asset Push. In early January 2026, Bank of America announced several new fixed-income offerings, adjusted its accounting for affordable housing and renewable energy investments, and faced regulatory scrutiny in India over a 2024 block trade while preparing to report fourth quarter 2025 results.
